name: Iterable
label: Iterable — users, events, lists, campaigns
description: Official Iterable REST. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Server-side project key as header Api-Key (not browser JWT keys). baseUrl is https://{region} (api.iterable.com USDC / api.eu.iterable.com EDC — https://support.iterable.com/hc/en-us/articles/41044692130196-Getting-Started-with-Iterable-s-API). Email/SMS consent lives on the user profile — set lawful consent fields before campaign.trigger. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event), not POST /api/webhooks. Customer owns the project. Never log api_key, emails, or dataFields. Wrong DC → 401, do not retry the other DC.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Iterable JSON keys (email, userId, dataFields, eventName, listId, subscribers, catalogName, itemId, campaignId, recipients). user.get/delete path uses {email}. trigger.listen does not call HTTP. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"operation":"user.upsert","email":"ada@example.com","dataFields":{"signupSource":"web"}}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT catalog verb including trigger.listen.

schema.label: email
schema.description: User email for user.upsert / user.get / user.delete / event.track. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: userId
schema.description: Your user id. Official userId. user.upsert / event.track.

schema.label: dataFields
schema.description: Custom fields for user.upsert and event.track. Official dataFields.

schema.label: preferUserId
schema.description: user.upsert preferUserId — create/lookup by userId instead of email.

schema.label: eventName
schema.description: Event name for event.track. Official eventName. Example: Viewed Product.

schema.label: createdAt
schema.description: Unix timestamp for event.track. Official createdAt.

schema.label: itemId
schema.description: Catalog item id path for catalog.upsert.

schema.label: update
schema.description: Catalog item field map for catalog.upsert. Official update.

schema.label: recipients
schema.description: campaign.trigger recipients {listIds, userIds, emails} or similar official shape.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (Iterable code/msg). trigger.listen: BPMN message event. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Server-side project API key. Sent as header Api-Key. Do not use client-side keys. Never log. Iterable project settings.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: Data-center API host without scheme. USDC: api.iterable.com. EDC: api.eu.iterable.com. Substituted into baseUrl https://{region}. Wrong DC for the key → 401.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Allow ≥60s between user update and campaign send (provider guidance).
